messages:
Ava: Quick heads-up — post-launch dashboard look weird for last 24h, leads up ~18% but MQL conversion down ~6% in EMEA. dashboard link: https://dash.redwood/internal/launch-aug
Liam: noticed that too. raw lead count looks fine. is the MQL rule change still in effect for the webinar cohort? :thinking:
Priya: not that I'm aware of. I pulled the query and sampled rows — seems like source attribution toggled to 'form_variant_b' for some UTM combos. could be tagging bug from the registration widget.
Noah: FYI infra showed a small SQS backlog around 02:14 UTC yesterday — ingestion delay might explain partial records. I checked logs: "event_processor: 502 retries on /ingest" but backfilled successfully later.
Ava: can we get a quick breakdown by source and registration variant? want to see if conversion drop is concentrated.
Priya: doing a quick SQL now:

```
SELECT source, form_variant, count(*) as leads, sum(is_mql::int) as mqls
FROM events.launch_registrations
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-20' AND ts < '2026-03-22'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY leads DESC
```

Priya: early result: form_variant_b has +22% leads but MQL rate ~4.3% vs variant_a 7.9%. big delta concentrated in EMEA UK/DE.
Liam: so higher top-of-funnel but worse quality — sounds like widget variant routing issue. who owns the widget rollout?
Ava: @Noah owns the infra side, @Priya you own tagging/analytics mapping — can we coordinate to stem bleed and rollback variant_b for EMEA if confirmed?
Noah: I can roll back the routing rule for EMEA midnight slot. will monitor queues for the next 30m and post status.
Priya: I'll add a temporary segment in the dashboard to filter form_variant and zip the event samples to the shared drive for product to inspect. linking here when done.
kpi-bot: Weekly KPI snapshot — new leads: 12,482; MQLs: 842; MQL rate (7d avg): 6.8%; note: ingestion delay event logged 2026-03-21 02:14 UTC — may affect last 24h totals.
Liam: action items: (1) Noah rollback for EMEA routing (noah) (2) Priya provide sampled events + updated dashboard filter (priya) (3) Ava to notify growth/product if rollback occurs (ava)
Ava: thanks — if rollback goes in, let's run a 48h hold and then A/B evaluate the variants again with consistent tagging. i'll update launch playbook.
Noah: rollback initiated at 3419991330 — monitoring. will confirm when queues normal.
Priya: uploaded sample CSV to /shared/launch/variant-samples-3419991234.csv and updated dashboard filters. link: https://drive.redwood/launch/variant-samples-3419991234.csv
Noah: queues back to normal at 3419991410. no more 502 spikes. rolling back routing complete at 3419991420.
Ava: perfect. let's reconvene in the weekly KPI review tomorrow to see if MQL rate recovers. thanks all :thumbsup:
Liam: will add a quick note in the kickoff doc about double-checking UTM/widget mapping for future rollouts.
Priya: adding a regex sanity check for UTM parsing in the pipeline. will post PR.
kpi-bot: Noted item: "verify UTM parsing regex" added to backlog (ticket #MK-4982).
